item.title: Dick Morris warns China-Taiwan flub may sink Graham's Senate bid
item.description: Political consultant Dick Morris said on Newsmax that a shaky debate answer on Taiwan policy could harm Sen. Lindsey Graham's re-election campaign.

item.title: Data center backlash emerges as bipartisan issue ahead of midterms
item.description: Data centers have become a rare bipartisan concern heading into the 2026 midterms, as reported by Newsweek, highlighting growing local opposition.

item.title: Colorado teacher faces backlash for wearing biological truth shirt
Teacher who battled union fears targeting after shirt complaint: 'I'm afraid'
item.description: Stacy Adair says she was reprimanded for wearing an 'XX ≠ XY' chromosome shirt at a training event, raising concerns about her job security.
